title_en: Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate, Second Branch v. Li Jiating — bribery case
keywords_en: criminal; crime of accepting bribes; trial of first instance; Intermediate People's Court; Beijing; Yunnan Province; state organ; Criminal Law; determination of the amount of bribes accepted; subjective knowledge; whether official authority was exploited; whether illegitimate benefits were sought; meritorious performance; accepting bribes; taking advantage of official position; seeking benefits for others; accepting property; joint acceptance of bribes with son
full_text_en:
Beijing Second Branch of the People's Procuratorate of Beijing Municipality v. Li Jiating — bribery case

Prosecutorial Authority: Beijing Second Branch of the People's Procuratorate of Beijing Municipality.

Defendant: Li Jiating, male, 59 years old, formerly Deputy Secretary of the CPC Yunnan Provincial Committee and Governor of the People's Government of Yunnan Province, residing at Xichang Road, Kunming City, Yunnan Province. Arrested on October 10, 2001.

The bribery case of defendant Li Jiating was initiated by the Beijing Second Branch of the People's Procuratorate of Beijing Municipality to the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court on March 6, 2003.

Indictment Allegations: From the first half of 1994 to July 2000, the defendant Li Jiating took advantage of his official position to seek benefits for multiple persons, and together with his son Li Bo or individually accepted bribes totaling RMB 10,380,000, HKD 6,490,000, USD 91,000, and JPY 200,000, equivalent to RMB 18,105,323.75 in total. The prosecutorial authority alleges that Li Jiating, as a state functionary, took advantage of his official position to seek benefits for others and accepted property from others, constituting the crime of bribery. The amount is huge and the circumstances are particularly serious.

Defendant's Defense: The defendant Li Jiating raised no objection to the basic facts of the crime alleged by the prosecutorial authority, but argued that: (1) he was unaware of the specific amount of money Li Bo had received; (2) he never actively solicited property from others; (3) the vast majority of matters he handled for others did not involve direct exercise of his authority; (4) his actions in seeking benefits for others did not cause direct economic losses to the State.

Defense Counsel's Arguments: The defense counsel for the defendant Li Jiating argued that: (1) Li Jiating's subjective awareness as to whether Li Bo and others were engaged in a partnership business required further verification; (2) Li Jiating was unaware of the specific amount of money Li Bo had received; (3) the benefits Li Jiating provided to some petitioners were not obvious; (4) some persons gave money to Li Jiating without making specific requests; (5) Li Jiating did not solicit property from others and basically did not seek improper benefits; (6) Li Jiating had a positive attitude in admitting guilt and had performed major meritorious service. The defense counsel submitted that Li Jiating should receive a mitigated punishment.

Facts Found by the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court through trial:

The defendant Li Jiating served successively as a member of the Standing Committee of the CPC Yunnan Provincial Committee, Vice Governor of the People's Government of Yunnan Province, Deputy Secretary of the CPC Yunnan Provincial Committee, and Governor of the People's Government of Yunnan Province from November 1992. From 1994 to July 2000, Li Jiating took advantage of his official position to seek benefits for others, and individually or together with his son Li Bo (separately prosecuted) accepted money from 10 persons on 30 occasions. The specific facts are as follows:

1. In September 1994, before Li Jiating visited the United States, he accepted USD 1,000 from Yang Rong, Chairman of Hong Kong Huande Co., Ltd. In early 1995, at the request of Yang Rong, Li Jiating called He Zhaoshou, Director of Yunnan Provincial Tobacco Monopoly Bureau, to give priority to Yang Rong in cigarette exports, enabling Yang Rong to obtain huge profits. During this period, Yang Rong proposed to Li Jiating to obtain a travel permit to Hong Kong and Macau for Li Jiating's son Li Bo. In May of the same year, Yang Rong spent RMB 500,000 to obtain a travel permit to Hong Kong and Macau for Li Bo under the false name "Li Bo" and informed Li Jiating. Li Jiating asked Yang Rong to take care of Li Bo's living expenses and financial matters in Hong Kong. Thereafter, Yang Rong deposited HKD 300,000 and HKD 500,000 respectively into accounts opened under the name "Li Bo" at the Hong Kong Branch of Bank of China and Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong), and handed the deposit books to Li Bo. In 1996, at Yang Rong's request, Li Jiating urged the Planning Department of the State Tobacco Monopoly Bureau to implement Yang Rong's cigarette export quota, and also called He Zhaoshou to give priority. During this period, Li Jiating again asked Yang Rong to take care of Li Bo. In September of the same year, when Li Jiating passed through Hong Kong on a return trip from an official visit, Yang Rong gave Li Jiating HKD 30,000. In January 1997, Yang Rong gave Li Bo HKD 5,000,000 in Hong Kong. In early 1997, Li Jiating introduced Yang Rong to Zhang Xiuliang, General Manager of Yunnan Provincial Petroleum Corporation, and facilitated the establishment of a joint venture, Yunnan Huafeng Petrochemical Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Huafeng Company"), with Yang Rong as Chairman. After the company became profitable, Yang Rong deposited HKD 300,000 into Li Bo's account at HSBC Hong Kong on two occasions in 1999 and 2000, respectively. Li Jiating, after learning of this, repeatedly instructed Li Bo: "This money is the common property of our family; do not squander it." To restrict Li Bo from using the received funds, Li Jiating also instructed his wife Wang Xiao and Li Bo in 1998 to open a joint account at HSBC Hong Kong.

Main evidence proving the above facts:

1. Testimony of witness Li Bo. Main contents: Yang Rong did business in Yunnan, and Li Jiating helped him a lot. In gratitude, in May 1995, Yang Rong spent RMB 500,000 to obtain a one-way travel permit to Hong Kong and Macau for him under the name "Li Bo" in Guangdong. In September of the same year, Yang Rong opened accounts under the name "Li Bo" at Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) and Bank of China (Hong Kong), depositing HKD 300,000 and HKD 500,000 respectively. In early 1997, Yang Rong gave him a check for HKD 5,000,000. In the second half of 1999 and January 2000, Yang Rong gave him two checks for HKD 300,000 each. He informed Li Jiating of all these matters. In response, Li Jiating repeatedly instructed: "This money is the family's money; do not touch it without permission." In 1998, to control his use of money, Li Jiating instructed him and his mother Wang Xiao to open a joint account at HSBC Hong Kong, depositing all the money given by Yang Rong and others into that account.

2. Testimony of witness Yang Rong. Main contents: In 1994, he heard that Li Jiating was going abroad for an inspection and gave Li Jiating USD 1,000. In early 1995, when Li Bo was about to graduate from university, he proposed to Li Jiating to obtain a one-way travel permit for Li Bo to settle in Hong Kong. In May of the same year, he spent RMB 500,000 to obtain the permit under the name "Li Bo." After Li Jiating learned of this, he asked him to take care of Li Bo's living and financial matters in Hong Kong. In August of the same year, he opened accounts for Li Bo at the Hong Kong Branch of Bank of China and Standard Chartered Bank, depositing HKD 300,000 and HKD 500,000 respectively. In 1995, he sought Li Jiating's help twice for cigarette exports, and Li Jiating instructed relevant departments to give priority. In September 1996, when Li Jiating passed through Hong Kong, he gave Li Jiating HKD 30,000. In January 1997, he gave Li Bo HKD 5,000,000 in Hong Kong. In early 1997, he planned to invest in petroleum products in Yunnan, and Li Jiating introduced him to Zhang Xiuliang, General Manager of Yunnan Provincial Petroleum Corporation. After negotiations, Huafeng Company was established as a joint venture, and he made a profit of over RMB 1,000,000. In the second half of 1999 and January 2000, he gave Li Bo HKD 300,000 on each occasion.

3. Testimony of witness He Zhaoshou. Main contents: In early 1995 and the first half of 1996, Li Jiating called him twice, asking him to give priority to Yang Rong in the variety mix of cigarette exports.

4. Testimony of witness Yang Youzhu. Main contents: When he served as Deputy Director of Yunnan Provincial Tobacco Monopoly Bureau, he followed He Zhaoshou's instructions and arranged for Yang Rong's cigarette exports through China Tobacco Yunnan Import and Export Co., Ltd.

5. Testimony of witness Zhang Xiuliang. Main contents: In April 1997, through Li Jiating's introduction, Yunnan Provincial Petroleum Corporation and Yang Rong established Huafeng Company as a joint venture, with Yang Rong as Chairman and legal representative. The company ceased operations after one and a half years, and Yang Rong received over RMB 1,000,000 in profits.

6. Certification materials from Maoming Public Security Bureau, Guangdong Province, and the "Travel Permit to Hong Kong and Macau (One-Way)" for "Li Bo." Proving that Yang Rong, in May 1995, obtained a one-way travel permit to Hong Kong and Macau for Li Bo under the name "Li Bo" at Maoming Public Security Bureau.

7. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: After Li Bo received money from Yang Rong, he repeatedly told Li Bo that this money was the family's money, to be kept safely in Hong Kong and not to be touched without permission. He also instructed Li Bo and Wang Xiao to open a joint account at a Hong Kong bank, depositing all the family's money and the money Yang Rong gave Li Bo into that joint account.

2. In 1996, Li Bo wanted to use Li Jiating's power and influence to make money. Li Jiating agreed and instructed Li Bo to find a partner and that he would contact relevant departments on his behalf. In April or May 1997, through Li Bo's introduction, Li Jiating accepted the requests of Li Jun, Chairman of Yunnan Junfa Real Estate Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Junfa Company"), and his father Li Liming, Chairman of Kunming Mingxing Housing Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Mingxing Company"), to help them secure the Luoshiwan Market renovation project in Wuhua District, Kunming City. Li Jiating called Liao Xiaoshan, Head of Wuhua District, to assist in coordination. Subsequently, without going through a bidding process, the Wuhua District Government signed an agreement with Mingxing Company to develop the Luoshiwan Market project, from which Mingxing Company profited over RMB 15,000,000. Li Jun promised to give Li Bo RMB 5,000,000 in the future. In early 1998, with Li Bo's consent, Li Bo's elder brother Li Qun withdrew RMB 2,000,000 from Li Jun. Later, Li Bo demanded another RMB 3,000,000 from Li Jun and proposed to borrow an additional sum for stock trading. In May of the same year, Li Jun provided Li Bo with RMB 7,500,000 by bank draft, of which RMB 4,500,000 was a loan. In October 1998, through Li Bo, Li Jiating accepted Li Jun's request to help Junfa Company obtain development rights for a garden residential community project in Kunming. Li Jiating referred a request from the Guandu District Government to Vice Governor Shao Qiwei and Deputy Secretary General Cui Zhitao of the Yunnan Provincial Government, instructing them to expedite coordination. At the end of 1998, the Guandu District Government signed an agreement with Junfa Company to develop the garden residential community project. In consideration, Li Jun forgave Li Bo's RMB 4,500,000 loan. In August 1999, when Junfa Company sought to lower the land price for the garden residential community project, Li Jun asked Li Jiating for help, and Li Jiating again instructed others to coordinate the matter. Li Bo informed Li Jiating of all the money received from Li Jun. Li Jiating instructed Li Bo to deposit the money in Hong Kong as family property.

Main evidence proving the above facts:

1. Testimony of witness Li Bo. Main contents: In the first half of 1996, he wanted to use Li Jiating's power and influence to make money through business and asked Li Jun to find projects for cooperation. Li Jiating, after learning of this, said: "You can make money with Li Jun in partnership, but don't appear in public. If anything comes up, let Li Jun come directly to our home to see me, and I can call relevant departments." In early 1997, Li Jun mentioned that the Luoshiwan Market in Wuhua District, Kunming, was to be renovated. Li Jiating asked Li Jun and Li Liming to come to his home for a meeting and helped them secure the Luoshiwan project. Li Jun and Li Liming made RMB 15,000,000 from it and promised to give him RMB 5,000,000. In early 1998, with his consent, Li Qun asked Li Jun for RMB 2,000,000. When he asked Li Jun for the remaining RMB 3,000,000, he also proposed to borrow money for stock trading. Li Jun later gave him a bank draft for RMB 7,500,000, of which RMB 4,500,000 was a loan. In the second half of 1998, Li Jun identified a piece of land in Guandu District and asked him to get Li Jiating to handle the approval documents. Li Jiating, after learning this, summoned Li Jun to his home for a meeting and helped Li Jun obtain 700 mu (approximately 46.7 hectares) of designated land. Li Jun later said that the borrowed RMB 4,500,000 did not need to be repaid.

2. Testimony of witness Li Jun. Main contents: Around March or April 1997, Li Bo told him that he wanted to make money through him in business. He discovered that the old Luoshiwan market was to be renovated and asked Li Bo to seek Li Jiating's help. After Mingxing Company obtained the development rights, it made a profit of over RMB 15,000,000. During the Spring Festival of 1998, Li Qun, with Li Bo's consent, asked him for RMB 2,000,000; in mid-May of the same year, he gave Li Bo a bank draft for RMB 7,500,000, of which RMB 3,000,000 was for the Luoshiwan project, and the remaining RMB 4,500,000 was a loan. In October 1998, he heard that the Guandu District Government had submitted a report to the city government requesting land use quotas for the World Horticultural Exposition. To help secure the quotas and obtain priority development rights, he asked Li Bo to get Li Jiating's help. After the report was approved, Li Bo told him that Li Jiating had taken a risk to accomplish this. Li Bo also said he had lost money in stock trading and could not repay the loan. He stated that without Li Jiating's involvement, it would have been very difficult to obtain the Luoshiwan project and the designated land for the garden community. He gave Li Bo so much money essentially to thank Li Jiating.

3. Testimony of witness Li Liming. Main contents: To secure the Luoshiwan market renovation project and obtain development rights for the garden residential community, he sought Li Jiating's help through Li Bo. In early 1998, he borrowed RMB 2,000,000 in cash from someone else and gave it to Li Jun as the money for Li Bo for the Luoshiwan project.

4. Testimony of witness Liao Xiaoshan. Main contents: In 1997, the district government planned to renovate the Luoshiwan market, and several companies were competing fiercely to participate. One evening, Li Jiating called him and introduced Li Liming and his son. He then introduced them to Deputy District Head Gao Jinsong and others. Later, the Luoshiwan market renovation project was awarded directly to Li Liming for construction without bidding.

5. Testimony of witness Gao Jinsong. Main contents: Following Liao Xiaoshan's instructions, the Luoshiwan market renovation project was awarded to Mingxing Company for construction.

6. Testimony of witness Cui Zhitao. Main contents: Pursuant to Li Jiating's instructions, he convened two coordination meetings regarding the inclusion of the garden residential community project as a key supporting project for the World Horticultural Exposition and the reduction of the project's land price.

7. Testimony of witness Zhang Zhong. Main contents: In June 1998, when he served as Head of Guandu District, he submitted a "Request for the Development and Construction of the Garden Residential Community Project, a Supporting Project for the '99 World Horticultural Exposition." After Li Liming sought Li Jiating's help, the provincial government approved the report, and the Guandu District Government gave priority to Li Liming and his son with 700 mu of designated land.

8. Endorsement copy of the Kunming Municipal People's Government's "Request for the Development and Construction of the Garden Residential Community Project, a Supporting Project for the '99 World Horticultural Exposition." Li Jiating's endorsement read: "Comrades Qiwei and Zhitao, this is an international practice (as with the Olympics and Expos). How should our province handle this? Please expedite coordination and provide opinions to avoid delaying the project schedule."

9. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: In 1996, Li Bo wanted to make money through business. He agreed and instructed Li Bo not to appear in public but to find someone to cooperate with, and he would contact relevant departments. Li Bo's role in the Luoshiwan market and garden residential community projects was merely to act as a liaison with Li Liming and Li Jun. The main reason Li Jun gave money to Li Bo was that he (Li Jiating) had intervened to help. Li Bo informed him each time after receiving money. He told Li Bo that this money was not easily earned and belonged to the family, and instructed Li Bo to deposit it safely in Hong Kong.

3. In September 1994, during a visit to the United States, Ge Jianhui, Deputy Director of the Yunnan Provincial Government's Beijing Office, arranged for his brother Ge Jinghui, who was residing in the United States, to give Li Jiating USD 2,000, hoping to receive Li Jiating's assistance for his personal development. Subsequently, when Ge Jianhui accompanied Li Jiating to Beijing to visit Ge Jinghui upon his return to China, Ge Jinghui gave Li Jiating another USD 10,000 and asked Li Jiating to support and help Ge Jianhui in his work. In February 1998, upon Li Jiating's proposal, Ge Jianhui was transferred to serve as Director of the Yunnan Provincial Government's Office in Shenzhen.

Main evidence proving the above facts:

1. Testimony of witness Ge Jianhui. Main contents: In September 1994, when Li Jiating went to the United States, he called his brother Ge Jinghui in the United States to host Li Jiating well and to pave the way for his own development. Later, Ge Jinghui said he gave Li Jiating USD 2,000. Subsequently, when Ge Jinghui returned to China, he gave Li Jiating another USD 10,000.

2. Testimony of witness Ge Jinghui. Main contents: Following Ge Jianhui's arrangements, he gave Li Jiating a total of USD 12,000 on two occasions, asking him to take care of Ge Jianhui's work.

3. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He received a total of USD 12,000 from Ge Jinghui on two occasions and proposed the transfer of Ge Jianhui's position.

4. Before the Spring Festival of 1995, Li Jiating accepted USD 10,000 from Shu Jian, Chairman of Kunming Jianhua Enterprise Group (hereinafter "Jianhua Group"), at his home. In February of the same year, when Shu Jian accompanied Li Jiating to Thailand to attend an investment trade fair, he gave Li Jiating another USD 5,000. In June or July of that year, Shu Jian repeatedly asked Li Jiating for assistance in obtaining loans. Li Jiating instructed Li Weibin, Deputy Governor of the Yunnan Provincial Branch of the People's Bank of China, and Zheng Xiaoren, President of the Kunming Branch of Bank of Communications, to help coordinate. Subsequently, Jianhua Group obtained a total of RMB 45,000,000 in loans from the Kunming Branch of Bank of Communications and Kunming City Credit Cooperative. To express gratitude to Li Jiating, Shu Jian gave Li Jiating USD 10,000 during the Spring Festivals of 1996 and 1999, respectively.

Main evidence proving the above facts:

1. Testimony of witness Shu Jian. Main contents: In January 1995, he gave Li Jiating USD 10,000. In February 1995, when he accompanied Li Jiating to Thailand for an investment negotiation, he gave Li Jiating USD 5,000. In June or July of the same year, he asked Li Jiating for help in obtaining loans. Li Jiating asked Li Weibin to help coordinate, enabling Jianhua Group to obtain a loan of RMB 25,000,000 from the Bank of Communications and a loan of RMB 20,000,000 from the City Credit Cooperative. To thank Li Jiating, he gave Li Jiating USD 10,000 during the Spring Festival of 1996 and another USD 10,000 during the Spring Festival of 1999.

2. Testimony of witness Li Weibin. Main contents: In the summer of 1995, Li Jiating asked him to help coordinate a loan for Shu Jian. In accordance with Li Jiating's request, he contacted Hu Gang and Zheng Xiaoren respectively.

3. Testimony of witness Zheng Xiaoren. Main contents: Li Jiating asked him to support the loan to Jianhua Group, and subsequently, Jianhua Group obtained a loan of RMB 25,000,000.

4. Testimony of witness Hu Gang. Main contents: When he served as President of Kunming City Credit Cooperative, Li Weibin asked him to support the loan to Jianhua Group, and subsequently, the credit cooperative granted a loan of RMB 20,000,000 to Jianhua Group.

5. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He received a total of USD 35,000 from Shu Jian on four occasions and helped coordinate loans for him.

5. Before the Spring Festival of 1996, Li Jiating accepted RMB 50,000 from Wang Wei, General Manager of Kunming Weishida Agricultural Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Weishida Company"), at his home. In May of the same year, Weishida Company invested in a project for the renovation and resettlement housing along Jinbi Road, which was developed in cooperation by Kunming Bolian Real Estate Development Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Bolian Company") and other companies. After the project was completed, the project headquarters refused to pay because Bolian Company had not paid the land transfer fee. In September 1997, Wang Wei and Liu Xiangyun, Chairman of Bolian Company, asked Li Jiating for help in resolving the matter. After Li Jiating endorsed a "Situation Report" instructing Feng Zhicheng, Deputy Mayor of Kunming City, and others, the project headquarters paid Bolian Company RMB 40,000,000, from which Wang Wei received RMB 6,500,000. To thank Li Jiating, Wang Wei gave Li Jiating RMB 100,000 and USD 10,000 before the Spring Festival of 1999.

Main evidence proving the above facts:

1. Testimony of witness Wang Wei. Main contents: Before the Spring Festival of 1996, he prepared RMB 50,000 in cash and went to Li Jiating's home. In Li Jiating's presence, he handed the money to Li Jiating's wife. In September 1997, after the completion of the Jinbi Road resettlement housing project in which he had invested, the project headquarters delayed payment. He and Liu Xiangyun went to Li Jiating's home to seek his help in coordination. Later, they gave a "Situation Report" to Li Jiating's secretary. The project headquarters soon paid a portion of the funds, and he received a total of RMB 6,500,000 from Bolian Company. To express gratitude to Li Jiating, he went to Li Jiating's home in January 1999 and gave Li Jiating USD 10,000 and RMB 100,000.

2. Testimony of witness Liu Xiangyun. Main contents: After the resettlement housing for demolition was completed, the Municipal Construction Company refused to pay. In July or August 1997, Wang Wei and he reported the relevant situation to Li Jiating's home, and Li Jiating said he would help coordinate a resolution. Li Jiating later made an instruction on the "Situation Report." The other party paid quickly, and Bolian Company paid Wang Wei RMB 6.5 million.

3. The instruction document on Bolian Company's "Situation Report." Li Jiating's instruction read: "Forward to Comrades Jianqiang, Chengyin, and Zhicheng of Kunming City for review and handling. Both parties to the cooperation should abide by the contract, especially government departments, which should win trust with sincerity and attract investment with trust. Otherwise, it will affect Kunming's investment environment and the degree and level of opening up."

4. Testimony of witness Feng Zhicheng. Main contents: In August or September 1997, based on Li Jiating's instructions, he instructed relevant personnel to negotiate with Bolian Company to resolve the dispute concerning the Jinbi Road demolition and resettlement housing project.

5. Testimony of witness Li Bingguang. Main contents: When he served as the commander of the Kunming Jinbi Road Reconstruction Command, an economic dispute arose with Bolian Company. After Deputy Mayor Feng Zhicheng instructed them to negotiate and settle the matter properly, they paid Bolian Company RMB 40 million as construction funds for the housing.

6. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He accepted a total of USD 10,000 and RMB 150,000 from Wang Wei on two occasions, and forwarded the "Situation Report" provided by Wang Wei to the relevant responsible persons in Kunming City.

VI. In early 1996, He Liwei, President of Yunnan Renhe Industrial Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Renhe Group), sought assistance because the change of the Pharmaceutical Business Enterprise Qualification Certificate was not approved when Renhe Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd., a subsidiary of the group, participated in the asset reorganization of Yunnan Provincial Health Development Corporation. After Li Jiating coordinated, the Yunnan Provincial Pharmaceutical Administration Office quickly handled the relevant change procedures. Afterwards, He Liwei gave Li Jiating RMB 60,000.

The main evidence proving the above facts includes:

1. Testimony of witness He Liwei. Main contents: In early 1996, due to the change procedures for the Pharmaceutical Business Qualification Certificate of Yunnan Provincial Health Corporation, he asked Li Jiating to come forward to coordinate. After Li Jiating made an instruction, the problem was quickly resolved. Afterwards, when he visited Li Jiating, who was studying at the Central Party School, he gave Li Jiating RMB 60,000.

2. The instruction document on the "Report on Changing the Pharmaceutical Business Qualification Certificate of Yunnan Provincial Health Development Corporation" submitted by Yunnan Provincial Health Corporation to the Yunnan Provincial Pharmaceutical Administration Office. Li Jiating's instruction read: "Comrades Chen Zhixiang and Li Shuji: The reorganization and change of a company are normal matters. Moreover, through reorganization, the company can be run better, which is very beneficial for prospering Yunnan's pharmaceutical market. Please provide support and assistance."

3. Testimony of witness Chen Zhixiang. Main contents: Renhe Group did not meet the conditions at that time. After Li Jiating's instruction, the relevant departments had no choice but to comply.

4. Testimony of witness Li Shuji. Main contents: In February 1996, Renhe Group cooperated with the Provincial Health Corporation and applied for a change of the Pharmaceutical Business Qualification Certificate. At that time, there were too many pharmaceutical wholesale enterprises in the province, so the change was not approved. Later, he heard from Chen Zhixiang that Li Jiating had instructed to provide support, so they handled the change procedures as soon as possible.

5. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He accepted RMB 60,000 from He Liwei and forwarded the relevant report to the responsible persons of the relevant departments.

VII. At the end of 1994, Wu Xinyuan, Chairman of the Board of Kunming Department Store (Group) Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Department Store Company), asked Li Jiating for help because the company's application to the Yunnan Provincial People's Bank for gold wholesale and processing businesses was not approved. Li Jiating asked Ni Guangzu, Deputy Governor of the Yunnan Provincial People's Bank, to provide support. Later, the Department Store Company obtained the right for gold wholesale and processing. In April 1996, Wu Xinyuan gave Li Jiating RMB 50,000 to express gratitude. In the second half of 1996, the Department Store Company wanted to connect the newly built building with the original building and applied for permission to build a pedestrian overpass, but it was not approved. Wu Xinyuan asked Li Jiating for help. Li Jiating instructed Feng Zhicheng, Deputy Mayor of Kunming, to provide support, and the Department Store Company was granted permission to build the overpass.

The main evidence proving the above facts includes:

1. Testimony of witness Wu Xinyuan. Main contents: Around 1994, the Department Store Company's application for gold wholesale and processing rights had been repeatedly denied. After he approached Li Jiating, the matter was accomplished. In April 1996, he gave Li Jiating RMB 50,000 in cash. In 1996, the Department Store Company wanted to build a pedestrian overpass between the old and new buildings but was not approved. After he asked Li Jiating to coordinate, the city government agreed.

2. Testimony of witness Ni Guangzu. Main contents: In early 1995, after Li Jiating asked him to support the Department Store Company's application for gold product processing and wholesale projects, he asked Wu Xinyuan to submit the application materials to the Head Office of the People's Bank of China.

3. Testimony of witness Feng Zhicheng. Main contents: In August or September 1996, when the Department Store Company proposed building a pedestrian overpass, Li Jiating requested the city government to provide support, and the city government agreed.

4. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He accepted RMB 50,000 from Wu Xinyuan and respectively requested Ni Guangzu and Feng Zhicheng to provide support to the Department Store Company.

VIII. In August 1996, Zou Lijia, General Manager of Kunming Jieda Industrial Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Jieda Company), asked Li Jiating for assistance in order to speed up the signing of an agreement with the Hongta Group for the joint construction of the B Block of Jiahua Plaza. Li Jiating instructed the relevant responsible persons of the Hongta Group to provide support and cooperation. Based on the instruction, the Hongta Group signed a relevant agreement with Jieda Company. In September of the same year, Zou Lijia gave Li Jiating USD 5,000 and HKD 30,000. In early 1998, Zou Lijia asked Li Jiating to help include Jiahua Plaza as a key supporting project for the "World Horticultural Exposition" to facilitate a bank loan. Li Jiating forwarded Zou Lijia's materials to the responsible vice governor for comments, and Jiahua Plaza was subsequently listed as a key supporting project for the "World Horticultural Exposition." In June 1998, Wal-Mart China Co., Ltd. (USA) wanted to cooperate with Jiahua House Development Co., Ltd., where Zou Lijia served as Chairwoman, and other entities to establish Kunming Wal-Mart Management Services Company, but the relevant departments disagreed. Zou Lijia asked Li Jiating for help. Li Jiating asked the responsible vice governor to coordinate and made an instruction. Afterwards, Zou Lijia went to Li Jiating's home and, in Li Jiating's presence, gave his wife Wang Xiao RMB 100,000. In June 1999, a dispute arose between Jieda Company and the Hongta Group over issues such as the construction period and payment for the B Block of Jiahua Plaza. Zou Lijia asked Li Jiating for help. Based on Li Jiating's instruction, the provincial government established a coordination leading group to preside over negotiations between the two parties, and an agreement was reached. In July 2000, Zou Lijia gave Li Jiating USD 5,000 and HKD 30,000.

The main evidence proving the above facts includes:

1. Testimony of witness Zou Lijia. Main contents: In September 1996, when Li Jiating passed through Hong Kong on his return from an overseas trip, she gave him USD 5,000 and HKD 30,000. In 1996, the Hongta Group intended to purchase the B Block of Jiahua Plaza, and she approached Li Jiating for his consideration. In September of the same year, the Hongta Group and Jieda Company signed a contract for the purchase of the B Block of Jiahua Plaza. Later, conflicts arose between the two parties, and she called Li Jiating to help resolve them. Li Jiating made an instruction, and the conflicts were resolved. To have the Jiahua Plaza project included in the supporting projects for the "World Horticultural Exposition" and to obtain a loan from the China Construction Bank, she submitted two reports to Li Jiating. After Li Jiating's instruction, Jiahua Plaza was listed as a supporting project for the "World Horticultural Exposition." In 1998, when preparing to introduce Wal-Mart to Kunming, she asked Li Jiating to assist with the work, and later the matter was accomplished. In the winter of 1998, at Li Jiating's home, in his presence, she handed RMB 100,000 to Wang Xiao. In July 2000, when Li Jiating was on an overseas trip, she gave him HKD 10,000; later, she separately gave him USD 5,000 and HKD 20,000.

2. Li Jiating's instruction on a letter from Zou Lijia. The contents read: "Please forward to Comrades Zhu Shijian, Zi Guorui, and Huang Yueqi of the Hongta Group for review and handling. It is suggested that the Board of Directors study this matter. If feasible, support and cooperation may be provided. In fact, this also supports Kunming's municipal construction and the work of the 1999 World Horticultural Exposition."

3. Testimony of witness Zi Guorui. Main contents: Due to Li Jiating's instruction, in September 1996, the Hongta Group signed an agreement with Zou Lijia for the purchase of Jiahua Plaza. During the construction, disputes arose multiple times between Zou Lijia and the Hongta Group over issues such as the building price and construction period. Later, Li Jiating sent people to mediate. The Hongta Group paid a total of over RMB 2.4 billion in project funds to Jieda Company.

4. The instruction document on Jieda Company's "Request for Explanation and Proposed Resolution Regarding the Origin of Conflicts with Yunnan Hongta Group in the Cooperative Construction of Jiahua Plaza." Li Jiating's instruction read: "Please, Comrade Kaitian, lead the leaders of the Provincial Construction Department, the Municipal Construction Committee, and other departments to, based on separately hearing the opinions of both sides, properly coordinate and handle this matter. The general principles are to handle according to the law and the contract (the cooperation agreement previously signed by both parties), according to customary practice, and to render a one-time final ruling."

5. Testimony of witness Du Kaitian. Main contents: Based on Li Jiating's instruction, he twice mediated the conflicts arising between the Hongta Group and Jieda Company during the joint construction of Jiahua Plaza.

6. The instruction document on Jieda Company's "Request to List Kunming Jiahua Plaza as a Reception Unit for the 1999 World Horticultural Exposition." Li Jiating's instruction read: "Comrades Liu Jing and Jingtai: Jiahua Plaza is the only five-star hotel that has been built or is under construction in Kunming. It is indeed necessary to list it as a reception unit for the World Horticultural Exposition. It is hoped that this project will be included in the supporting projects of the World Horticultural Exposition."

7. The instruction document on the "Report on Review Opinions of the Kunming Jiahua Plaza Project" submitted by Yunnan Branch of China Construction Bank to its Head Office. Li Jiating's instruction read: "Comrade Yingying: Jiahua Plaza is the only five-star hotel that has been built or is under construction in Kunming. It is a main reception facility (especially for foreign guests) for next year's World Horticultural Exposition. The provincial and municipal governments have decided to include it as a supporting project for the World Horticultural Exposition. Please discuss with President Shuai of the Provincial Construction Bank how to seek support from the Head Office. If necessary, when you go to Beijing, you can report to the Head Office together with the leaders of the Provincial Construction Bank. During the National People's Congress session, I plan to speak with the leaders of the Head Office."

8. The instruction document on the "Report on the Demonstration Opinions Regarding Wal-Mart's Establishment of an Enterprise in Kunming." Li Jiating's instruction read: "Agree with the opinions of the coordination meeting. Please, Comrade Qiwei, handle the work with the Kunming Municipal Government (including the High-tech Zone) well, and ensure prompt implementation."

9. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: On three occasions, he accepted a total of RMB 100,000, USD 10,000, and HKD 60,000 from Zou Lijia; and he accepted Zou Lijia's requests and provided assistance in matters concerning the joint construction of Jiahua Plaza, listing Jiahua Plaza as a supporting project for the "World Horticultural Exposition," applying for loans, and cooperating to establish the "Wal-Mart" company.

IX. In October 1996, when the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Yunnan Branch, was selecting a president, Li Jiating accepted the request of Li Zhongping, the Vice President of the Branch. At the meeting of provincial party secretaries and when the organizational department sought his opinion, Li Jiating expressed agreement with the promotion of Li Zhongping to President. In December of the same year, the Head Office of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China formally appointed Li Zhongping as President of its Yunnan Branch. That same evening, Li Zhongping gave Li Jiating USD 10,000. From November 1997 to January 1999, Li Zhongping also gave Li Jiating a total of RMB 20,000, USD 2,000, and JPY 200,000 on four separate occasions.

The main evidence proving the above facts includes:

1. Testimony of witness Li Zhongping. Main contents: In October 1996, he spoke with Li Jiating about wanting to become President and asked for his consideration. Li Jiating said he would speak up for him at the appropriate time. In December of the same year, the Head Office formally appointed him as President of the Yunnan Branch. To thank Li Jiating, he invited Li Jiating to dinner and gave him USD 10,000. In 1997, upon learning that Li Jiating was going abroad, he gave him USD 2,000. Later, he also gave Li Jiating RMB 20,000 and JPY 200,000 on separate occasions. The money he gave was all public funds.

2. Testimony of witness Li Suhua. Main contents: In the second half of 1996, when he served as a Division Chief in the Organization Department of the Yunnan Provincial Party Committee, he conducted an assessment of Li Zhongping. When seeking Li Jiating's opinion, Li Jiating expressed agreement.

3. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He accepted Li Zhongping's request and, at the meeting of provincial party secretaries and when the organizational department sought his opinion, he expressed agreement with Li Zhongping's promotion to President of the Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, Yunnan Branch. He accepted a total of USD 12,000, RMB 20,000, and JPY 200,000 from Li Zhongping on five occasions.

X. In early 1997, Hong Kong Jinshili Group Co., Ltd. intended to jointly establish a cigarette factory in Cambodia with Yunnan Provincial Tobacco Company and Cambodia Xu's Group Co., Ltd. Li Zhengui, the Chairman of the Board of Jinshili Group, asked Li Jiating for help. In March of the same year, after accepting USD 10,000 from Li Zhengui at his home, Li Jiating spoke with the relevant responsible persons of Yunnan Provincial Tobacco Company, facilitating the signing of a letter of intent for the joint establishment of the cigarette factory by the three parties. In June 2000, Li Jiating again accepted USD 1,000 from Li Zhengui.

The main evidence proving the above facts includes:

1. Testimony of witness Li Zhengui. Main contents: In 1996, he wanted to participate in the joint establishment of a cigarette factory in Cambodia with Yunnan Provincial Tobacco Company and asked Li Jiating for help. In 1997, he gave Li Jiating USD 10,000 at Li Jiating's home. In 1998, he and the relevant parties signed a letter of intent for cooperation. In 2000, he again gave Li Jiating USD 1,000.

2. Testimony of witness Zhang Shuichang. Main contents: When he served as the Executive Deputy General Manager of Yunnan Provincial Tobacco Company, Li Jiating spoke to him about Li Zhengui's desire to jointly establish a cigarette factory in Cambodia, asking him to facilitate this matter.

3. Confession of Li Jiating. Main contents: He accepted a total of USD 11,000 from Li Zhengui and provided assistance for the joint establishment of a cigarette factory in Cambodia.

In summary, the defendant Li Jiating, alone or in collusion with his son Li Bo, accepted bribes from others totaling RMB 10.38 million, HKD 6.49 million, USD 91,000, and JPY 200,000, equivalent to a total of over RMB 18.10 million. After the case was discovered, the procuratorial organs recovered and seized RMB 11,279,848.94, HKD 2,781,119.86, USD 474,396.4, JPY 356,000, 18 watches valued at RMB 910,340, and 10 pieces of jewelry valued at RMB 96,462.

Regarding the defense opinion that it is necessary to ascertain whether Li Bo and Li Jun were engaged in a joint business venture, the court finds upon investigation: The defendant Li Jiating himself confessed that Li Bo only acted as a liaison between the Li Liming and Li Jun father-son duo in the two projects of Luoshiwan Market and Garden Residence; the reason Li Jun gave money to Li Bo was primarily because Li Jiating, by virtue of his authority as Governor, did things for the Li Liming father-son duo, such as signing reports and making phone calls. Li Bo testified that in the Luoshiwan Market renovation and Garden Residence community projects, he neither invested nor did anything; it was solely Li Jiating who used his power and influence to assist Li Jun; the Li Liming father-son duo gave him RMB 9.5 million to thank Li Jiating. Accordingly, the evidence is indeed and sufficient to establish that Li Jiating knew Li Bo and Li Jun were not engaged in a joint business venture, but rather that he used his official position to seek benefits for Li Jun, and Li Bo accepted money from Li Jun on his behalf.

Regarding the defense opinion that the benefits Li Jiating sought for Shu Jian and Li Zhongping were not obvious, the court finds upon investigation: After accepting the requests, Li Jiating asked the relevant bank responsible persons to coordinate regarding Shu Jian's loan matters, helping him obtain a loan of RMB 45 million; after accepting the request, when the relevant department assessed and promoted Li Zhongping, Li Jiating clearly expressed his agreement with Li Zhongping's promotion. Li Jiating's actions of seeking benefits for the above two individuals were obvious.

Regarding the defense opinion that Ge Jianhui's requests were not specific and the evidence to establish that Li Jiating sought benefits for him was insufficient, the court finds upon investigation: Ge Jianhui hoped that Li Jiating would support and care for his work, and the requests were specific; based on Li Jiating's confession and the testimonies of Ge Jianhui and Ge Jinghui, Li Jiating accepted the requests, proposed and facilitated Ge Jianhui's job transfer. The fact that Li Jiating sought benefits for Ge Jianhui is fully supported by sufficient evidence.

Regarding the defense opinion that although Wu Xinyuan asked Li Jiating for help regarding the Kunming Department Store's construction of a pedestrian overpass, the "Meeting Minutes" of the Kunming Municipal Government General Office dated July 18 of the same year had already agreed in principle to the construction of the overpass, creating a contradiction in the evidence concerning the above request, the court finds upon investigation: The aforementioned "Meeting Minutes" did not contain any content agreeing in principle to the construction of the overpass.

Regarding the defense opinion that Wang Wei's gift of RMB 50,000 to Li Jiating, Li Zhengui's gift of USD 1,000 to Li Jiating, and Li Zhongping's subsequent four gifts of money to Li Jiating were all without specific requests, and therefore these amounts should not be included in the bribe amount, the court finds upon investigation: All three individuals had specific requests, and Li Jiating also used his official position to seek benefits for them. Whether the acceptance of money occurred before or after seeking benefits does not affect the determination of the nature of Li Jiating's bribery.

Regarding the defense and argument that Li Jiating was unaware of the specific amount of money Li Bo accepted, the court finds upon investigation: Li Jiating had prior knowledge of and conspired with Li Bo regarding the money Li Bo accepted from Li Jun; after Li Bo accepted money from Yang Rong, he explicitly informed Li Jiating; after Li Bo accepted money from Li Jun and Yang Rong, Li Jiating explicitly told Li Bo that all the money received constituted family common property. Since Li Jiating did not personally handle the acceptance of these sums, it is normal that he did not know the precise amounts received. However, this does not affect the determination of the nature of Li Jiating's conduct as bribery, nor can it constitute a circumstance for a lighter punishment.

Regarding the defense and argument that Li Jiating did not actively demand property from others; that the majority of matters he handled for others did not fall within his directly supervised scope of authority, and that he did not cause direct economic losses to the state, the court finds upon investigation: The indictment of the prosecutorial authority did not allege that Li Jiating demanded property, nor did it allege that he caused direct economic losses to the state, nor did it distinguish whether the benefits sought for others utilized his directly supervised scope of authority. Among the benefits Li Jiating sought for others, there were indeed improper benefits. Seeking improper benefits may be a circumstance for discretionary heavier punishment, but seeking legitimate benefits cannot serve as a reason for a lighter punishment.

Regarding the defense opinion that Li Jiating had a positive attitude of admitting guilt, performed major meritorious service, and should receive a reduced punishment. Confirmed by the procuratorial authorities, Li Jiating's act of reporting others' criminal conduct played an important role in the investigation authorities' solving of related cases, has constituted a meritorious service, and may be considered as a circumstance at sentencing.

The Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court holds:

Article 385(1) of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (hereinafter referred to as the Criminal Law) stipulates: "Any state functionary who, by taking advantage of his office, extorts money or property from another person, or illegally accepts another person's money or property in return for securing benefits for the person, is guilty of acceptance of bribes." The defendant Li Jiating, a state functionary, took advantage of his office to seek benefits for others, and accepted money or property from others alone or in collusion with his son Li Bo. His conduct constitutes the crime of acceptance of bribes. The facts of Li Jiating's crime of acceptance of bribes charged by the prosecutorial authority are clear, the evidence is indeed and sufficient, and the charge is established. The amount of bribes accepted by Li Jiating is extraordinarily huge, the circumstances of the crime are particularly serious, and according to the law, the crime warrants the death penalty. However, given that Li Jiating has performed meritorious service by reporting others' criminal conduct, has admitted guilt and expressed remorse, and all illicit money has been recovered, the death penalty may be imposed but not immediately executed. In accordance with Article 385(1), Article 386, Article 383(1)(1), Article 48(1), Article 57(1), Article 68(1) of the Criminal Law, and Article 5 of the Supreme People's Court's "Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Cases of Surrender and Meritorious Service," the Beijing Second Intermediate People's Court rendered the judgment on May 9, 2003:

一、被告人李嘉廷犯受贿罪，判处死刑，缓期二年执行，剥夺政治权利终身，并处没收个人全部财产。

二、追缴的赃款上缴国库；扣押在案的物品退回北京市人民检察院第二分院处理。

1. The defendant Li Jiating was convicted of the crime of bribery and sentenced to death, suspended for two years, with deprivation of political rights for life and confiscation of all personal property.

2. The recovered illicit money shall be turned over to the State Treasury; the seized items shall be returned to the Second Branch of the Beijing Municipal People's Procuratorate for disposal.

宣判后，李嘉廷提出上诉。李嘉廷上诉理由是：他揭发他人犯罪的事实应构成重大立功，至少也是特殊的立功，具备再从轻处罚的法律和事实依据。

After the judgment was pronounced, Li Jiating filed an appeal. The grounds for Li Jiating's appeal were: his disclosure of others' criminal conduct should constitute a major meritorious performance, or at least a special meritorious performance, and there were legal and factual bases for further lightening his punishment.

李嘉廷的辩护人认为：李嘉廷提供线索的行为，符合重大立功的法定条件，应对其减轻处罚。李嘉廷只是受贿犯罪，没有涉嫌其他犯罪；行贿人请托的大多属于合法事项；李嘉廷为他人办事大多是利用职务影响而非职权；没有造成直接重大经济损失；李嘉廷没有索贿情节；赃款大多已追缴，且积极认罪悔罪；故在量刑上应充分予以考虑。

Li Jiating's defense counsel argued that: Li Jiating's act of providing leads met the statutory conditions for a major meritorious performance, and his punishment should be mitigated. Li Jiating only committed the crime of bribery and was not suspected of other crimes; most of the matters requested by the bribe-givers were lawful; Li Jiating mostly used his positional influence rather than his authority to handle matters for others; no direct major economic losses were caused; Li Jiating did not have any circumstance of soliciting bribes; most of the illicit money had been recovered, and he actively confessed and showed remorse; therefore, these factors should be fully considered in sentencing.

北京市高级人民法院审理查明，一审判决中所列举的认定本案事实的证据，均在一审开庭审理时当庭宣读、出示并质证，李嘉廷及其辩护人上诉时均未提出新的证据，对一审判决认定的证据予以确认。一审判决的事实清楚，证据确实、充分。

The Beijing High People's Court, upon trial, found that all evidence listed in the first-instance judgment for determining the facts of the case had been read out, presented, and cross-examined in court during the first-instance trial. Neither Li Jiating nor his defense counsel presented new evidence on appeal, and the evidence affirmed in the first-instance judgment was confirmed. The facts found in the first-instance judgment were clear, and the evidence was reliable and sufficient.

北京市高级人民法院认为：

The Beijing High People's Court held that:

对于上诉人李嘉廷及其辩护人提出的李嘉廷提供线索，检举他人犯罪的行为属于法定重大立功表现，要求再予从轻处罚、减轻处罚的上诉理由及辩护意见，经查，李嘉廷的行为不符合法律关于重大立功的规定。故李嘉廷及其辩护人要求再予从轻、减轻处罚的意见缺乏依据，不予采纳。

Regarding the appellate grounds and defense opinions raised by appellant Li Jiating and his defense counsel that Li Jiating's act of providing leads and reporting others' crimes constituted a statutory major meritorious performance, and that a further lightened or mitigated punishment should be imposed, upon investigation, Li Jiating's conduct did not meet the legal provisions on major meritorious performance. Therefore, the opinions of Li Jiating and his defense counsel seeking further lightened or mitigated punishment lacked basis and were not adopted.

对于上诉人李嘉廷提出的其立功具有特殊性，要求再予从轻处罚的上诉理由及其辩护人提出的李嘉廷具有积极认罪悔罪，赃款大多已追缴，未造成重大损失，在量刑上应充分予以考虑的辩护意见，经查，法律并未有特殊性立功的规定，一审判决在量刑时已充分考虑其立功表现，赃款已全部追缴，积极认罪悔罪等情节，量刑适当。

Regarding the appellate ground raised by appellant Li Jiating that his meritorious performance had special characteristics, seeking a further lightened punishment, and the defense opinion raised by his defense counsel that Li Jiating had actively confessed and showed remorse, most of the illicit money had been recovered, no major losses were caused, and these factors should be fully considered in sentencing, upon investigation, the law does not contain provisions on special meritorious performance. The first-instance judgment had already fully considered his meritorious performance, the full recovery of illicit money, his active confession and remorse, and other circumstances in sentencing, and the sentence was appropriate.

对于上诉人李嘉廷的辩护人提出的其他对李嘉廷在量刑时应予充分考虑的辩护意见，由于所列情节均不属于法定从轻处罚的情节，故均不予采纳。

Regarding the other defense opinions raised by appellant Li Jiating's defense counsel that various circumstances should be fully considered in sentencing, since none of the listed circumstances constituted statutory grounds for lightened punishment, they were all not adopted.

综上，李嘉廷身为国家工作人员，利用职务上的便利，为他人谋取利益，单独或伙同其子李勃非法收受他人钱款，其行为已构成受贿罪。李嘉廷利用职务之便收受巨额贿赂，其行为严重侵害了国家工作人员职务的廉洁性，损害了国家工作人员的声誉，破坏了国家机关的正常工作秩序，犯罪情节特别严重，应依法惩处。一审法院根据李嘉廷犯罪的事实、性质、情节和对于社会的危害程度，鉴于李嘉廷有立功表现，并提供线索，对侦破相关案件起了重要作用，且认罪悔罪，赃款已全部追缴的情节作出的判决，定罪及适用法律正确，量刑适当，审判程序合法，应予维持。据此，北京市高级人民法院依照《中华人民共和国刑事诉讼法》第一百八十九条第（一）项之规定，于2003年6月20日裁定：

To summarize, Li Jiating, as a state functionary, took advantage of his position to seek benefits for others and, individually or jointly with his son Li Bo, illegally accepted money from others. His conduct constituted the crime of bribery. Li Jiating accepted enormous bribes by taking advantage of his position, and his conduct seriously infringed upon the integrity of state functionaries in performing their duties, damaged the reputation of state functionaries, disrupted the normal working order of state organs, and the circumstances of the crime were particularly serious. He should be punished according to law. The first-instance court, based on the facts, nature, circumstances, and degree of harm to society of Li Jiating's crime, and in view of his meritorious performance, his provision of leads that played an important role in solving related cases, his confession and remorse, and the full recovery of illicit money, rendered a judgment with correct conviction and application of law, appropriate sentencing, and lawful trial procedures, and such judgment should be upheld. Accordingly, the Beijing High People's Court, pursuant to Article 189(1) of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, on June 20, 2003, ruled:

驳回李嘉廷上诉，维持原判。

Li Jiating's appeal is dismissed, and the original judgment is affirmed.
